Name: Shared Community Center Rewards
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
Created this for a multiplayer save I had with some friends (Which we never finished, as usual, btw).
It will send the claimed bundle reward to every other player who did not collect it initially, along with one of three little messages from the forest spirits.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10506]
[/url]﻿
[size=5]How to install : [/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder

[url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/SharedCCRewards][Source Code][/url]
